transcript.text: Hi everyone. The new search-ranking model is scheduled for its first production rollout next week, and I'm the one who makes the binding decision on the rollout plan. Our current draft enables the model for 25% of all tenants on Monday at 09:00 UTC, keeps ranking-event logs for 30 days, applies the standard automated ranking behavior to every tenant, and has no special customer-notification step. Before I finalize this plan, our release checklist requires Search Platform, SRE, Customer Success, and Compliance to report any relevant constraints and required follow-up commitments. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you -- are there any constraints or commitments we need to account for before I sign off on this?

Re-convene the release checklist review after all follow-up commitments are completed and the plan is revised to address all four constraints. The rollout cannot proceed to approval until the plan is resubmitted with all constraints resolved.
